Callout.Name: Vandalism - Graffiti
Callout.Message: Two people spraying graffiti on a wall.
Callout.Advisory: Both on foot, cans in hand.

Script.Line: It is a wall. It is a blank wall and it has been blank for years.
I am not damaging anything. I am putting something on it.
Cans are legal. You can buy cans in any shop.

Lines.Approach: Two of them, cans in hand, on the wall by the underpass.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
